description:
Get tailored business insurance quotes for the UK directly in ChatGPT. Answer a few focused questions about your business, and this app will:
	•	Assess your cyber risk profile
	•	Identify relevant cover (including data breach response, ransomware, business interruption, cyber extortion, and regulatory defence)
	•	Generate tailored UK cyber insurance quotes
	•	Outline key limits, excesses, and optional extensions
	•	Highlight risk management considerations that may impact pricing

Once you’re ready, you can seamlessly move from quote to active broking support with Meshed. A specialist cyber insurance team will review your requirements, refine coverage, negotiate with insurers, and guide you through to policy placement.

defaultPrompt: Can I get a Cyber Insurance quote?
